entities.name: William IV, Landgrave of Hesse-Kassel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: William IV of Hesse-Kassel, also called William the Wise, was the first Landgrave of the Landgraviate of Hesse-Kassel. He was the founder of the oldest line, which survives to this day.
